# Native normal final-clear evidence

The three unchanged packet pairs were captured by protected app 2.7.118 on Beast.
`normal-one-perfect.png`, `normal-two-perfect.png` and `normal-three-perfect.png`
show actual normal ordinals one, two and three. Their original exported deals and
failure metadata are retained alongside them. `provenance.json` records all source
paths and SHA-256 identities. The `*-flying.png` files are the original first
mismatch, not substitutes for the final observation.

The normal Perfect artwork moves through the bottom-row upper absence bands.
Native-v18 therefore opts into a separate final-only proof: the complete normal
header and New footer, original independent scene anchors, all 21 upper-row top
felt bands and all seven bottom-row lower felt bands, plus exact exclusive pile
identities. Each band is 60×4 native pixels and requires 240/240 unchanged felt
pixels. Its offset is `(40,4)` for slots 0–20 and `(40,164)` for slots 21–27.
These strips lie inside any remaining card's visible face and outside the
retained normal Perfect artwork. No resize, text reconstruction or colour-limit
change is introduced.

The full empty-circle and exhausted-stock cross patterns are copied unchanged
from native-v17. A cross replaces DRAW scene evidence only when both replayed
piles and independently recognised piles are empty. This grants no REDEAL input.
The new capability is explicit schema-2 data; removing `normal_final_clear` and
restoring the profile identity recovers the entire decoded v17 profile.

The caller must establish the final whole-action acknowledgement boundary and an
independently replayed empty tableau. This evidence proves BoardClear only.
Ordinary acquisition/partial-position recognition, final observation bounds,
STOP/context guards, next-board observation and shared GAME WIN remain separate.
Offline replay and repeated AF_UNIX fixture captures do not establish a fresh
native Continuous run, GAME WIN, restart, or human acceptance of this revision.
